name: react-native-best-practices
headline: Boost: Laravel MCP Server for AI Development
short_description: Boost is a Laravel-focused MCP server designed to enhance your AI-powered local development experience. It streamlines workflows and integrates AI capabilities, making it an essential tool for developers working with Laravel.
author: laravel

sections.overview:
Boost is a Laravel-focused MCP server designed to integrate AI capabilities into your local development workflow. It provides tools for executing PHP code within your application context through its Tinker MCP tool, enabling AI agents like Claude to interact directly with Laravel applications. The server streamlines AI-powered development by offering structured access to your Laravel project, making it easier for developers to leverage AI assistance while maintaining full control over their codebase. Boost is actively maintained and compatible with popular AI coding tools that support the Model Context Protocol.
Enhancing local Laravel development workflows by automating repetitive tasks.
Integrating AI features into Laravel applications for smarter functionality.
Streamlining development processes with an MCP server to reduce setup time.
Facilitating rapid prototyping of Laravel applications with AI-generated code.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install laravel/boost`
`git clone https://github.com/laravel/boost`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
